From nearby Hazrat Nizamuddin station, the Vande Bharat 22470 leaves 6:00 AM and arrives 7:40 AM, and the Gatimaan Express 12050 leaves 8:10 AM and arrives 9:50 AM.

IRCTC blocked me, so these times come from another site and the page was cut off after 11:15 AM. Seats and fares aren't checked, so confirm them on IRCTC before you plan around them.
